toolprompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: horizontal character turnaround sheet for a game art reference
Input image 1 is the approved Iris no-coat character design and the only visual reference. Preserve Iris exactly: young adult woman, silver-white very long hair with half-up braid and purple ribbon, light violet eyes, calm gentle expression, ivory ruffled blouse with purple neck ribbon, purple vest with gold buttons, brown belt, navy long skirt with pale-lavender hem band and ivory ruffle, brown boots with no front laces and two round gold buttons on each boot, and one brown book held in front in the original design.
Create one wide horizontal sheet with exactly THREE full-body drawings of the same Iris, equally spaced left to right, identical scale, same head-top and foot-bottom baseline:
1) FRONT: strict 0-degree front-facing neutral standing view.
2) SIDE: strict 90-degree true side profile facing RIGHT; nose, chest and toes point right, back of head left. No three-quarter.
3) BACK: strict 180-degree rear view.
Neutral turnaround pose: arms slightly away from torso and naturally lowered. Keep the book from obscuring the torso: show it as a small separate prop inset near the bottom of the sheet, and draw all three bodies with empty natural hands at their sides. The separate book inset is the only extra object. Feet parallel, no dramatic action pose or exaggerated T-pose. Preserve the half-up braid, ribbon, hair length, skirt hem and boots through rotation; back view is only a restrained logical continuation. Full hair and feet visible, identical scale and baseline, generous spacing.
Background: flat white to warm ivory, no perspective, no dramatic light, no large ground shadows. Add only small English labels FRONT, SIDE, BACK below figures. No other text, no character name, no watermark.
Avoid: any 3/4 angle, mirrored side direction, adding a coat, changing inner clothing, laced boots, extra props beyond one small book inset, extra figures, child/chibi proportions, cropped head or feet.
